connector.name: Teneo Book Generation
connector.registryDescription: Generate complete nonfiction books with Teneo: outline, manuscript, cover, and PDF/EPUB/DOCX files.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package teneo-book-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the traviseric account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TENEO_API_KEY
env.description: Per-agent API key from the Teneo dashboard. Books are charged to this key owner's Teneo credit balance.

env.name: TENEO_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional Teneo API base URL. Defaults to https://teneo.io. Use https://staging.teneo.io for staging.

env.name: TENEO_SERVICE_KEY
env.description: Optional ecosystem service key alternative to TENEO_API_KEY.

env.name: TENEO_ON_BEHALF_OF
env.description: Required when using TENEO_SERVICE_KEY. Teneo user id whose credits are charged.
